# Public PDF fixtures

These original PDF files are used only as static inputs to the local ML HTTP tests. They are not generated by the test parser.

| Filename | Source URL | Physical pages checked | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| `cbr-inflation-expectations-2024-01.pdf` | https://www.cbr.ru/Collection/Collection/File/47804/Infl_exp_24-01.pdf | 2 of 11 | `ad659e26473e98f7eb1994cb35c0b3df13fc4d7732dc8fd61b5eeddd200e0a02` |
| `ecb-monetary-policy-2024-04-11.pdf` | https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/press_conference/monetary-policy-statement/shared/pdf/ecb.ds240411~58dd9ec73d.en.pdf | 1 of 6 | `bda91748c6a300184d7ba72d246bd60e3a00ae0a0b9dd7889675f69cbe646db4` |

The expected landmarks are recorded directly in the parameterized test: the CBR page includes `снизилась до 12,7%`, `9,8%`, `7,2%`, and `5,1%`; the ECB page includes `4.50%, 4.75% and 4.00%` and states that the rates remain unchanged. Whitespace is normalized when checking extracted text.
